summary: Assist to Rocky Mountain Rescue Group in search for a 50-year-old man in the Caribou area
responding_agency: Alpine Rescue Team, Rocky Mountain Rescue Group
notes: ART mission 2023-012. BCSO release detail: 50-year-old man from Louisville overdue after a Sunday 2023-02-26 snowboard trip near Old Caribou Townsite; vehicle found at trailhead Mon morning; found ~6:30 p.m. Mon 2023-02-27 hiking to self-rescue after overnighting in a self-built shelter and running in place for warmth; treated and released; ~40 SAR personnel (incl. Alpine, CO Army National Guard helicopter, drones), case 23-1090.
